title: KeaterBang's Cutscene ModPack Collection
description: A Collection of Mods and Resource Packs Used in KeaterBang's Forever World Cutscenes on YouTube!
body:
This is a collection of mods I use for all of the cutscenes in my videos. This pack may not receive frequent updates! This pack includes the mods, resource packs, and the shader (with my personal cofigs) I use in my Minecraft video cutscenes! The only mod I use that is not in this modpack is "Kenjis Combat Forms'. You will have to download it from curseforge at this link "https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/epic-fight-kenjis-combat-forms".
The version you will need to be compatible with this pack is "-1.0.4 - 1.20.1-KenjisCombatForms-forge-jar".
